bio.text: Steven Feldman is the Libertarian candidate for North Carolina's 10th Congressional District in 2026 and lists his occupation as physician.

According to his campaign website, he is a physician and medical scientist who has lived in North Carolina for more than 40 years and received his medical training at Duke University and the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.
